nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used across bonding, market, governance and initialization entry points.
Block timestamp used to derive epoch state and time-dependent checks.
Global protocol balance accounting (supply, bonded, staged, redeemable, debt, coupons).
Per-account state mapping holding balance, staged, coupons, locks.
Governance candidate state including votes, approvals and initialization flag.
EIP-1967 proxy implementation storage slot written via assembly sstore.
External deposit that pulls dollars via transferFrom then updates staged balance.
External withdraw that transfers dollars out then decrements staged balance.
External bond that mints internal balance based on totalBonded/totalSupply ratio.
External unbond that computes staged return and burns internal balance.
External coupon purchase that burns caller dollars and credits coupons.
External coupon redemption that decrements coupons and transfers dollars to caller.
External coupon transfer with allowance-less sender forwarding.
Internal routine minting dollars and adjusting debt; called from initialize and incentivized.
Internal routine pulling and burning dollars from an account.
Internal routine transferring dollars to an account and reducing redeemable.
Internal invariant assertion comparing contract balance to bonded+staged+redeemable.
Internal supply regulation driven by oracle price capture.
External governance commit that upgrades the proxy to the winning candidate.
External super-majority emergency commit that upgrades the proxy.
Internal proxy upgrade that stores the implementation and delegatecalls initialize().
External epoch advance executing bonding, regulator and market steps with incentives.
Initializer that mints the advance incentive to msg.sender.
Computes current epoch index from block.timestamp using epoch strategies.
Timestamp accessor returning block.timestamp, overridable for testing.
External token call pulling funds from a caller-supplied account before state update.
External token call sending funds out to a caller-supplied recipient.
External privileged token mint call reachable from non-restricted entry points.
delegatecall into the new implementation executing initialize() in proxy context.
Deposit amount parameter controlling the transferFrom and staged increment.
Bond amount parameter used in the share calculation and staged decrement.
Coupon purchase dollar amount parameter burned from the caller.
Computed coupon amount credited to the caller after adding premium.
Epoch parameter selecting which coupon balance to redeem.
Candidate implementation address written to the proxy slot and delegatecalled.
Local share amount derived from value and totalSupply/totalBonded ratio.
Local cached current epoch for coupon crediting.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the account whose staged balance is credited after transferFrom.
msg.sender determines the recipient of the outbound dollar transfer.
msg.sender is burned from and credited coupons in purchaseCoupons.
msg.sender coupons are decremented and dollars are sent to msg.sender.
msg.sender is compared against sender to skip allowance decrement.
msg.sender receives the minted advance incentive during initialization.
msg.sender receives incentive mint in the incentivized modifier on advance.
block.timestamp is returned directly, making epoch progression timestamp dependent.
epochTime consumes the timestamp accessor to derive the current epoch.
block.timestamp indirectly determines epoch transitions and coupon expiry windows.
deposit performs an external transferFrom before staged state is fully updated.
deposit writes the caller staged balance into account state.
withdraw performs an external transfer before decrementing the staged balance.
withdraw updates the caller staged balance in account state.
bond mutates totalBonded and supply using ratio arithmetic subject to rounding.
bond increments the caller internal balance in account state.
unbond reduces totalBonded using division-based share computation.
purchaseCoupons delegates the dollar burn to burnFromAccount.
redeemCoupons delegates the dollar payout to redeemToAccount.
mintToAccount invokes the privileged external mint on the dollar token.
burnFromAccount performs an external transferFrom on the caller-supplied account.
redeemToAccount performs an external transfer before balance bookkeeping settles.
balanceCheck reads bonded, staged and redeemable global balances.
Regulator.step adjusts debt and supply from oracle-derived deltas.
commit triggers a proxy upgrade after quorum checks.
emergencyCommit triggers a proxy upgrade after super-majority checks.
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on the attacker-influenced implementation.
upgradeTo writes the new implementation into the EIP-1967 storage slot.
advance mints incentives via mintToAccount to caller and legacy pool.
advance drives the regulator step during epoch progression.
initialize mints the advance incentive to msg.sender without restriction.
deposit amount parameter bounds the pulled value and staged increment.
bond amount parameter drives the share and totalBonded updates.
dollarAmount parameter is burned and used in premium calculation.
couponAmount is derived via addition and premium math credited to caller.
couponEpoch parameter selects the coupon bucket to redeem.
newImplementation parameter becomes the delegatecall target and stored implementation.
local balance derived from ratio math becomes the credited internal balance.
local epoch value is used to index coupon balances when purchasing.

normalization_plan.reason: Deposit amount parameter is bound solely to the deposit function arguments and folded into its transferFrom and staged update.
Bond amount parameter only participates in the bond share computation and staged decrement.
Dollar amount parameter is local to purchaseCoupons and its burn/premium computation.
Computed coupon amount is only used for crediting within purchaseCoupons.
Coupon epoch parameter selects the redemption bucket within redeemCoupons only.
Candidate address parameter is consumed exclusively by the upgrade flow in upgradeTo.
Local share variable is a temporary intermediate for the bond balance computation.
Cached epoch local is only used to index coupon balances within purchaseCoupons.
